use_cases: Display animated counters for statistics and metrics on dashboards
Show smoothly incrementing prices or values in e-commerce product pages
Animate numerical values in real-time data visualizations
Create engaging countdown timers with spring-physics animations
Display financial data with smooth value transitions
ai_summary: A SlidingNumber component that displays numbers with a smooth spring-physics sliding animation effect. Each digit transitions independently using Framer Motion's useSpring and useTransform hooks, creating a cascading effect when values change. The component supports padding, decimal separators, and uses dynamic height measurements to calculate precise vertical offsets for the sliding animation.
